CONTACT US BEFORE YOU APPLY!
Our admissions staff is here to provide thoughtful guidance as you make important decisions about your education. Apply now and let us know how we can support your exciting plans for the future.
JSNN encourages early applicants! Ph.D. applications are processed on a continuing basis, and decisions on admission are made when the application file is complete.
NANOENGINEERING APPLICATION
PROCESS
Our Nanoengineering admissions follows the NC A&T Graduate School admissions process. All application materials should be submitted through the NC A&T Graduate School.
Questions about the graduate program should be directed to the NE Graduate Program Director Dr. Emanuel Waddell.
